program_name: Doctor of Philosophy in Pharmaceutical Sciences
duration: Full-time – Minimum : 3 years, Maximum : 5 years | Part-time – Minimum : 4 years, Maximum: 7 years

fees.notes: QIU does not publish programme fees on its own website; its programme pages state fees/funding are by enquiry (https://qiu.edu.my/programmes/, checked 2026-09-18). Third-party enrolment platform Uni Enrol lists the international total fee for this programme as USD 20,669.90 over 3 years (USD 6,889.97/year). Source: https://unienrol.com/study-malaysia/quest-international-university-qiu/44635-doctor-of-philosophy-in-pharmaceutical-sciences (accessed 2026-09-18).
